parameters.name: Cron
parameters.description: The Cron expression for the upgrade start time.

parameters.name: CronDay
parameters.description:
The day of the week for the upgrade time. Valid values:
- **MON**: Monday
- **TUE**: Tuesday
- **WED**: Wednesday
- **THU**: Thursday
- **FRI**: Friday
- **SAT**: Saturday
- **SUN**: Sunday.

parameters.name: CronTime
parameters.description: The publish start timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: CronType
parameters.description:
The upgrade start cycle type. Valid values:
- **day**: every day
- **week**: every week.
